question: The sentence 'I saw the man with the binoculars' is <blank> because it's unclear whether I used the binoculars or the man had them.

question: The detective remained skeptical of the suspect's alibi; not only was his description of the timeline incredibly <blank>, but his answer regarding who he was with was highly <blank>, leaving it unclear whether he meant his brother or his boss.
